subject: insurance-business-law-08-2022
note: Written after the encoding landed, so that the routing names real arms. The sweep covers only what is listed under `searches`, each with what it does not cover. In particular it did not read any decree or circular that implements the Law.

searches.question: Which gazette issues and files carry Law 08/2022/QH15?
searches.scope: The Government gazette's page for the Law, congbao.chinhphu.vn/van-ban/luat-so-08-2022-qh15-37510/41184.htm, read for its links to PDF files.
searches.coverage_note: The page was used to find the two gazette PDFs (issues 575+576 and 577+578). Its list of related documents, if it has one, was not read, so this search says nothing about amendments.

searches.question: Has Law 08/2022/QH15 been amended, and from when?
searches.scope: The Government gazette's page for Law 139/2025/QH15, congbao.chinhphu.vn/van-ban/luat-so-139-2025-qh15-468699.htm, and the gazette PDF it links to (issue 39 of 22 January 2026), read in full.
searches.coverage_note: Establishes what Law 139/2025/QH15 says. It does not establish that no other instrument amends the Law.

searches.question: Which instruments does the official consolidation say amend the Law?
searches.scope: The header of the Office of the National Assembly's consolidated text no. 31/VBHN-VPQH, dated 13 March 2026 (datafiles.chinhphu.vn/cpp/files/vbpq/2026/3/31-vbhn-vpqh.pdf, sha256 68a62eb33e710334e2cc9ad8ad223f53ee33db6b235302585208bf3eea9225c9), which names Law 139/2025/QH15 as the only amending instrument.
searches.coverage_note: Current only to 13 March 2026. The rest of the consolidation was used to check the amendment list and is not a source of the encoding; poppler reported three flate-stream errors on the PDF.

searches.question: What does the commentary say Law 139/2025/QH15 changed and when?
searches.scope: Search-engine results for Vietnamese queries naming Law 139/2025/QH15 and Law 08/2022/QH15: summaries of commercial legal-information sites, the Government gazette and the consolidation.
searches.query: Luật 139/2025/QH15 sửa đổi Luật Kinh doanh bảo hiểm 08/2022/QH15 hiệu lực
searches.coverage_note: Commercial sites were not relied on for any date: the dates in the entries are read from the gazette text of Law 139/2025/QH15 itself (S2).

searches.question: Which decrees and circulars implement the Law, and have they changed since Law 139/2025/QH15?
searches.scope: Search-engine result summaries for Vietnamese queries naming the Law, Decree 46/2023/NĐ-CP and Circular 67/2023/TT-BTC.
searches.query: Nghị định hướng dẫn Luật Kinh doanh bảo hiểm 08/2022/QH15 Nghị định 46/2023/NĐ-CP Thông tư 67/2023/TT-BTC còn hiệu lực sau Luật 139/2025/QH15
searches.coverage_note: Only result summaries were read. No decree or circular was opened, so which of their articles survive Law 139/2025/QH15 is not known.

searches.question: Is a further amendment of the Law enacted or pending?
searches.scope: Search-engine result summaries for a Vietnamese query about a draft law amending the Law on Insurance Business in 2026.
searches.query: dự thảo sửa đổi Luật Kinh doanh bảo hiểm 2026 Quốc hội kỳ họp
searches.coverage_note: Inconclusive. The results described a 27-article bill that matches Law 139/2025/QH15 itself, and one result carried a page date that may be the site's current date rather than the article's. This does not establish that no further bill is before the National Assembly.

searches.question: What does the legal-document portal's relations diagram show for the Law?
searches.coverage_note: The page returned only loading messages to the fetching tool, so this search established nothing.

entries.summary: Law 139/2025/QH15, Điều 1 (15 clauses) and Điều 2 clauses 1 to 5 and 7, amends, adds, replaces and repeals provisions of Law 08/2022/QH15 from 1 January 2026: Điều 3 (new clause 3), 63(3)(b)-(c), 73, 74(3)(b), 81, 82(4) and (6), 87(3), (3a), (5), (6), 101, 127(1), 134, 138 (new 3a), 151(2)(đ), 154, 156 (clauses 2, 3(b)-(c) and a new clause 4) and 157(2); phrase changes at Điều 8, 11, 13, 152 and 153; repeal of Điều 64(1)(a) and (4), 69, 71(3), 117(3) and 133(1)(a) and (4).

provenance.citation: Luật số 139/2025/QH15 ngày 10 tháng 12 năm 2025, Điều 1, Điều 2(1)-(5) and (7), Điều 3(1); Công báo số 39 ngày 22-01-2026

routing.rule_version_arm: The V2 arms: every rule that Law 139/2025/QH15 changed has a branch on `the rules in force are those of V2 or later` (law08-vintage.l4, a function of `RULES EFFECTIVE DATE`), in the module for its Điều; the clause-by-clause landing is in encodings/legalese-2026-10-vn-29/registers/roadmap-law139-2025-qh15.json.

entries.disposition_note: All 25 numbered clauses of the amending Law are units of roadmap-law139-2025-qh15.json and every one is encoded; the forks and findings that concern the amendments are in NOTES.md sections 3 and 4 (this register has no machine-format fork register to link to).

entries.summary: Law 139/2025/QH15, Điều 2 clauses 6 and 8, take effect on 1 July 2026 (Điều 3(2)): the phrase 'dịch vụ phụ trợ bảo hiểm qua biên giới' is struck from Điều 6 and 'hoạt động dịch vụ phụ trợ bảo hiểm' from Điều 9, and Điều 143 (conditions for ancillary services) and Điều 155 (amendment of Appendix IV of the Investment Law) are repealed.

routing.rule_version_arm: The V3 arms: branches on `the rules in force are those of V3` (law08-vintage.l4): Điều 143 and Điều 155 answer that they do not exist from 2026-07-01, and the phrases of Điều 6 and 9 are struck (roadmap-law139-2025-qh15.json, units Điều 2(6) and Điều 2(8)).

entries.disposition_note: Encoded as vintage V3. NOTES.md section 4 records what the repeals leave dangling (findings W4 and W5).

entries.summary: Implementing instruments reported by search-result summaries: Decree 46/2023/NĐ-CP and Circular 67/2023/TT-BTC, said to remain applied after Law 139/2025/QH15; Decree 97/2026/NĐ-CP (31 March 2026) said to amend the decree; Circular 96/2026/TT-BTC said to amend the circular from 2 July 2026. Reported, not read.

provenance.url_absent_reason: No instrument was opened; the figures above are what a search summary reported and are unverified.

entries.disposition_note: Subsidiary legislation is outside this encoding. Where the Law delegates to the Government or the Minister of Finance, the encoding has a named REFUSE with a test (NOTES.md section 1), so nothing in these instruments is assumed.

dispositions.note: Clause Điều 1(n) is marker A<n>, clause Điều 2(n) is marker B<n>; each is a unit of roadmap-law139-2025-qh15.json with disposition encoded.
